description: Spec-driven development methodology and MCP server for AI coding agents: 8 phases from vision to validation, bi-directional V→S→A→SP→PL→TK traceability, and three coverage invariants, exposed as 3 `vdd_*` tools over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
rules: Connect the hosted endpoint https://vdd.simonmak.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no API key) or run locally with `npx -y @simonmak-ascent/mcp`.
Read the phase's skill first (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, served as `skill://<name>/SKILL.md`), write the artifact yourself, then call `vdd_check` with `{phase, content, priorArtifacts}`.
`vdd_check` judges one artifact; `vdd_chain_validate` judges all six at once and checks every goal reaches a task; `vdd_amend` lists the downstream artifacts a change invalidates.
No tool writes files, reads a filesystem or calls a model. There is no `projectRoot` and no write path: the host agent owns every edit.
A PASS requires invariants A, B and C together: every parent has a child, every child names a known parent, every parent has a dedicated child.
`prompts/list` returns `[]`. 2.0.0 ships no prompts — the nine skills are the procedures.
